sources.notes: First accelerating pass-by at Italia a Zandvoort 2013; uploader identifies the Ferrari F93A. Spectator-camera footage visually inspected, including the matching Ferrari in the second pass at 15 s. Rising engine harmonics and gear changes are present in the first pass, with baked-in Doppler, crowd and track ambience. No tachometer or calibrated RPM: idle, redline and complete rev coverage are not established. Not a ready RPM loop.
